subject: info-dy
title: INFO.DY.------ATTN.
description: Diagram closing R(AS)CM(II)-22, the section on how television, articles, and university courses positively educate listeners about classical music — and the *absence* of equivalent positive-media-involvement for alternative creativity. The prose immediately above names what the crossing diagrams: 'Only with this type of positive media involvement can anyone expect to really increase awareness of alternative creativity.' The crossing diagrams what information-dynamics actually crosses with when attention is the working partner: INFO-DY (information dynamics — the form's own information output) is crossed with ATTN (attention — the receiving listener's actual focused awareness). INFO-DY sits at the upper-right with the subject-arrow; ACC-DY (accent dynamics) rises above-left and ACT (action) anchors the upper-left as the subject's upper output. VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) sits at the right with INDIV-TD (individual transformation-dynamics) below it, then COS-P (cosmic-particulars) and AFI (affinity insight) on the lower-right as the subject's downward chain. ATTN sits centrally as partner-axis; SPT-DY (spectacle dynamics) and C-INFO (central information) anchor the lower-left as partner-side downward outputs. Structural argument: the right-side chain VT-DY → INDIV-TD → COS-P → AFI is the *positive-media-involvement chain* the prose names — information-dynamics routes through vibrational-dynamics into individual transformation-dynamics, then into cosmic-particulars, and finally into affinity-insight. This is the chain western-classical-music receives because the upper diagonal ACC-DY → ACT routes accent-dynamics into action that holds the right-side chain open. The partner-axis ATTN → SPT-DY / C-INFO is what attention produces on its own when the upper diagonal is *not* held — spectacle-dynamics and central-information without the affinity-insight terminus. For alternative creativity, the upper diagonal does not get held; attention routes directly into spectacle-dynamics and central-information without traversing the right-side chain. The 'positive media involvement' the prose names is structurally the ACC-DY → ACT diagonal: it must run, or the partner-side absorbs attention into spectacle without ever reaching cosmic-particulars or affinity-insight.
